name: vacuum_cost_page_dirty
description: Cost assigned when VACUUM dirties a previously clean page, reflecting I/O overhead of flushing the modified page to disk.
symptoms: Vacuum taking too long to complete
Unpredictable vacuum runtime under mixed workloads
Increased contention with foreground queries during vacuum
tuning_tips: Increase this value (e.g., 40–100) to slow down vacuum when dirty-page I/O is expensive or competing with critical queries; decrease (e.g., 5–20) to allow faster vacuum if storage is fast and vacuum lag is problematic.
